desc_zh: 按客户项目要求提供合成纸印刷成品，可选择整卷交付或裁切成单张。
desc_en: Custom synthetic paper print production, available as full rolls or cut sheets according to the project.

detail_zh.lead: 适用于海报、促销画面及其他展示项目的合成纸印刷成品。可根据后续使用、安装和运输需求，选择整卷交付或裁切成单张。
highlights: 按项目指定尺寸和数量印刷
applications: 需要后续加工或使用的印刷单张
delivery: 按指定尺寸裁切成单张
根据交付形式和目的地核算包装及运费
detail_zh.artwork: 可接收印刷文件，也可提供文件准备服务。基础文件检查和简单调整可免费提供；较大幅度修改或从零设计需单独报价。
detail_zh.brief: 请说明成品尺寸、数量、卷装或单张偏好、覆膜要求、设计文件及目的地。
detail_zh.caveat: 可供宽度、厚度、表面类型及其他技术规格，需要根据具体产品需求逐项确认后报价。

detail_en.lead: Custom synthetic paper printing for posters, promotional graphics and other display projects. Choose roll delivery or individual cut sheets to suit handling, installation and freight requirements.
highlights: Printed to project-specific dimensions and quantities
applications: Printed sheets for further handling or finishing
delivery: Packing and freight assessed by order format and destination
detail_en.artwork: Supply a print-ready file or ask for artwork preparation. Basic file checks and minor adjustments are available at no extra cost; extensive modifications or original design work are quoted separately.
detail_en.brief: Please specify finished size, quantity, roll or sheet preference, lamination requirement, artwork and destination.
detail_en.caveat: Available widths, thicknesses, surface options and other technical specifications are confirmed for each requested product before quotation.
